annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale de développement de la mobilité routière automatisée 2020-2022
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for the Development of Automated Road Mobility 2020-2022
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de la Transition écologique / Ministère de l'Économie (Ministre délégué chargé des Transports; Ministre déléguée chargée de l'Industrie); France Véhicules Autonomes
annotation.summary_en: French government's second national strategy for automated road mobility 2020-2022. It sets a vision of deploying automated mobility services in France in 2022-2025, identifies five collective challenges (driverless operation, connectivity, safety validation, acceptability, data), and lists dated measures on regulation, safety references, cybersecurity, training and funding.
key_provisions_or_claims: Finalise legal framework under LOM articles 31-32 for automated vehicles and related data (2021-2022)
Produce safety demonstration reference frameworks for passenger services and urban logistics
Develop French doctrine on critical scenarios for validation and EU cybersecurity certification
Estimated €300M public support 2021-2025 for pilots, demonstrators and services
Align with EU and UN regulation, including Vienna Convention adaptation for highly automated vehicles
